minLength: Must contain at least {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}.
maxLength: Must contain at most {count, plural, one {# character} other {# characters}}.

dateRange.endBeforeStart: End date cannot be before start date.
dateRange.startAfterEnd: Start date cannot be after end date.
dateRange.dateResetNotice: End date has been reset because it preceded the new start date.

minAge: Minimum required age is not met at the given date.

date.notInPast: This date cannot be in the past.
date.notInFuture: This date cannot be in the future.

leave.notInPast: Leave start date cannot be in the past.

contract.cddMaxDuration: A fixed-term contract cannot exceed 24 months (Cameroon law).

expense.futureDate: An expense cannot be dated in the future.

timesheet.futurePeriod: Cannot enter a timesheet for a future month.

medical.nextBeforeCurrent: Next appointment date must be after the current visit.
